zh: 导入的看板 SQL 里如果用了没定义的表别名（例如写了 t.字段，但 FROM 表后面漏了 t），且只有一张表，会自动补上别名并在改写说明里注明；改写规则更新后，已导入的看板不用重新导入就按新规则计算。
en: Imported dashboard SQL that uses an undefined table alias (for example t.column without the alias after the only FROM table) now gets the alias added automatically, noted in the rewrite notes; imported dashboards follow updated rewrite rules without being re-imported.
